canonical.description: Aza'ra is a shattered, disc-shaped world suspended in the Void. Its four continents, Dakaroth, Arzuhan, Tzaphaer, and Belavadós, share a single magical enclosure called the Veil. Floating islands drift above the land; a twisted, fractured cone narrows beneath the disc. The Veil is a mostly transparent dome which holds clouds and water inside, and beyond it life cannot survive. The sun is dead or nearly dead. The Veil and the three moons it illuminates supply the world's living light.
